headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — TELANGANA
verified_by: IANS wire carried identically by Munsif, Hans India, SocialNews.XYZ, Punjab Kesari (13 Sep ~19:20 IST)
TGCSB Director Shikha Goel's on-record statement at Lok Adalat event
key_facts: Rs 139.68 crore refunded to 24,189 cyber fraud victims in 2026 till now
national Lok Adalat (Hyderabad): Rs 42.28 crore to 3,896 victims
Cyberabad top unit Rs 14.19 crore/942 victims; TGCSB Rs 10.55 crore/41; Malkajgiri Rs 5.27 crore/1,024
MRM module (since June): Rs 27.23 crore to 9,355 victims without court orders; since inception Rs 514.93 crore/73,204
bullets_en: Telangana Police have refunded Rs 139.68 crore to 24,189 cyber fraud victims in 2026 so far.
At a national Lok Adalat in Hyderabad, Rs 42.28 crore was returned to 3,896 victims.
Cyberabad topped with Rs 14.19 crore to 942 victims; TGCSB and Malkajgiri followed.
The MRM portal has returned Rs 27.23 crore to 9,355 victims since June, without court orders.
bullets_ur: Telangana police ne 2026 mein ab tak 24,189 cyber fraud victims ko Rs 139.68 crore wapas kiye.
Hyderabad ke national Lok Adalat mein 3,896 victims ko Rs 42.28 crore lautaye gaye.
Cyberabad sabse aage: 942 victims ko Rs 14.19 crore; uske baad TGCSB aur Malkajgiri.
MRM portal ke zariye June se 9,355 victims ko Rs 27.23 crore mile, bina court order ke.
